data.narrative: Suspicious activity involving account ACC-70921 held by Viktor Petrov (CUST-20015), a high-risk customer with prior SAR history. Account exhibited minimal transaction activity over 24-hour period totaling $182.49 at low-risk merchants (Whole Foods, Netflix), inconsistent with typical behavior for a business checking account averaging $287K monthly balance. Customer profile indicates enhanced due diligence status, import/export trading business, and links to accounts under investigation. External fraud database queries reveal email address v.petrov.trading@protonmail.com is flagged in FinCEN 314(b), ACAMS, and FraudNet consortium reports for suspected structuring and trade-based money laundering. Despite low dollar volume, behavioral anomaly combined with high-risk indicators and confirmed fraud led to account freeze (FRZ-2026-07001) and chargeback initiation (CB-2026-03001). Activity is indicative of potential account takeover testing or low-value probing following credential compromise.
